alt: The Grind & Unwind café storefront with AI-generated food display photos visible in the window and graffiti on the facade
story: Grind & Unwind café in San Francisco used AI-generated images on their storefront menu that looked like food hallucinated by a model that had never seen food, sparking enough online fury that someone spray-painted 'SERIOUSLY' on the facade — costing the owner $700 to clean.
why_funny: The AI was given one job: make people want to eat here. It produced images that made people want to spray-paint the building.
